content.text: ## Memoriam Redacta _by San Jaya Prime_ As one that I've spoken about very publicly -- a risky venture indeed! -- let's have a Google Search for "Memoriam Redacta" tell the story for us. "Memoriam redacta" translates from Latin as an edited, redacted, or erased memory, and serves as the title of a popular digital fractal art piece created by artist Jaya Prime. * About the Artwork -- Visual style: Combines circular black-and-white fractals with imagery of shattered, bullet-marked glass * Theme: Represents broken memories and an unspoken, mysterious past. * Reception: Won high placement in online digital art community contests in 2017. Thanks Googz, I'll take it from here. This book is on a ticking clock, where I need to finish it _before_ it becomes reality. That could be ten or less years for the "real thang" at this point, possibly even less than five. In _Neuromancer_, they're called "stims"; in the movie _Strange Days_, they called it the SQUID; in _Cyberpunk_ they call it "braindancing"; Robert Nozick's philosophical concept where a person plugs into a machine was called, simply, "The Experience Machine" -- you need only understand one of these to know where this is going. Two stories run simultaneously through the book, having been sparked in the same moment, then diverging wildly until the final reunion where everything converges. I had the outline in place years ago... then the format to follow came together right before the pandemic. I'm making a few tweaks to the science as I talk through feasibility and theory alongside Treebeard, an AI that I created with Google Gemini. I'm unsure yet if I'll have this among my set of traveling books, but that decision is coming up fast and heavy. Note: The cover comes from my "[Oz the Great and Powerful](other-fractals)" symbol fractal, which as Google mentioned, has won its own awards and features alongside this new, more visceral version. You can find the "Memoriam Redacta" shattered fractal itself on Redbubble ([link](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/25883468)). * * * ### Extended Exploration Fans of "Memoriam Redacta" will almost certainly love my "[IO Limiters](io-limiters)" album, which just might make the perfect soundtrack to the book. However, the mix of emotions and cerebral elements also leans it towards my "[Blood of the Moon](blood-of-the-moon)" DJ set. From my written works, oddly enough it's nearest to "[At the End of the Way](at-the-end-of-the-way)".
